description: Footgun automatic context and trap matching: at session start, scan this project locally and add a short note of the traps that apply to its package versions (off when auto_context is false). When a shell command fails, search known traps with its error, secrets and paths removed, and say when the same command keeps failing the same way (searching is off when auto_search is false). Before a shell command runs, pause and ask first when it looks destructive, such as dropping a database, destroying infrastructure or deleting the project. In a git repo, at the start of a new session, save an undo point of the project's files that /footgun:undo restores, without touching the working tree or the index (both off when safety_net is false).
